programs.label: Reading & Tajweed
programs.description: Builds accurate, rule-governed Qur'anic reading from first letter recognition through fluent, beautified recitation (tarteel).

kids.desc: Recite with tarteel across multiple juz; command advanced rules and waqf signs.

adults.name: Letter Mastery & Foundational Tajweed
adults.desc: Articulate all 28 letters correctly; read joined words; apply foundational Noon Sakinah rules.

adults.name: Fluent Reading & Core Tajweed
adults.desc: Recite a full juz applying major tajweed rules; self-monitor and correct errors.

adults.name: Mastery & Tarteel
adults.desc: Recite with tarteel across multiple juz; command advanced rules (Qalqalah, Ghunnah, waqf).
